schema.text: By bicycle or e-scooter, what problems do you find at this crossing?

options.text: The cycle path stops before or after the crossing
There is no crossing for bicycles: people use the zebra crossing
Cars do not give way to bicycles
Cars or motorcycles stopped on the cycle path near the crossing
A curb or step at the entrance of the cycle path
The cycle path is not physically separated from motor traffic

en.#By bicycle or e-scooter, what problems: By bicycle or e-scooter, what problems do you find at this crossing?
en.#The cycle path stops before or after th: The cycle path stops before or after the crossing
en.#There is no crossing for bicycles: peop: There is no crossing for bicycles: people use the zebra crossing
en.#Cars do not give way to bicycles: Cars do not give way to bicycles
en.#Cars or motorcycles stopped on the cycl: Cars or motorcycles stopped on the cycle path near the crossing
en.#A curb or step at the entrance of the c: A curb or step at the entrance of the cycle path
en.#The cycle path is not physically separa: The cycle path is not physically separated from motor traffic

it.#By bicycle or e-scooter, what problems: In bici o in monopattino, quali problemi trovi in questo attraversamento?
it.#The cycle path stops before or after th: La ciclabile si interrompe prima o dopo l'attraversamento
it.#There is no crossing for bicycles: peop: Non c'è un passaggio per le bici: si usano le strisce pedonali
it.#Cars do not give way to bicycles: Le auto non danno la precedenza alle bici
it.#Cars or motorcycles stopped on the cycl: Auto o moto ferme sulla ciclabile vicino all'attraversamento
it.#A curb or step at the entrance of the c: Un cordolo o un gradino all'ingresso della ciclabile
it.#The cycle path is not physically separa: La ciclabile non è separata fisicamente dal traffico motorizzato

fr.#By bicycle or e-scooter, what problems: À vélo ou en trottinette électrique, quels problèmes rencontrez-vous sur ce passage ?
fr.#The cycle path stops before or after th: La piste cyclable s'interrompt avant ou après le passage
fr.#There is no crossing for bicycles: peop: Il n'y a pas de passage pour les vélos : on utilise le passage piéton
fr.#Cars do not give way to bicycles: Les voitures ne cèdent pas le passage aux vélos
fr.#Cars or motorcycles stopped on the cycl: Voitures ou motos arrêtées sur la piste cyclable près du passage
fr.#A curb or step at the entrance of the c: Une bordure ou une marche à l'entrée de la piste cyclable
fr.#The cycle path is not physically separa: La piste cyclable n’est pas physiquement séparée de la circulation motorisée

de.#By bicycle or e-scooter, what problems: Mit dem Fahrrad oder E-Scooter: Welche Probleme haben Sie an diesem Übergang?
de.#The cycle path stops before or after th: Der Radweg endet vor oder nach dem Übergang
de.#There is no crossing for bicycles: peop: Es gibt keinen Übergang für Fahrräder: man nutzt den Zebrastreifen
de.#Cars or motorcycles stopped on the cycl: Autos oder Motorräder halten auf dem Radweg nahe dem Übergang
de.#A curb or step at the entrance of the c: Ein Bordstein oder eine Stufe an der Einfahrt zum Radweg
de.#The cycle path is not physically separa: Der Radweg ist nicht baulich vom Kraftfahrzeugverkehr getrennt

tr.#By bicycle or e-scooter, what problems: Bisikletle ya da elektrikli scooterla bu geçitte hangi sorunlarla karşılaşıyorsunuz?
tr.#The cycle path stops before or after th: Bisiklet yolu geçitten önce ya da sonra kesiliyor
tr.#There is no crossing for bicycles: peop: Bisikletler için geçit yok: yaya geçidi kullanılıyor
tr.#Cars or motorcycles stopped on the cycl: Geçidin yakınında bisiklet yolunda duran araba ya da motosikletler
tr.#A curb or step at the entrance of the c: Bisiklet yolunun girişinde bordür ya da basamak
tr.#The cycle path is not physically separa: Bisiklet yolu motorlu araç trafiğinden fiziksel olarak ayrılmamış

fa.#By bicycle or e-scooter, what problems: با دوچرخه یا اسکوتر برقی، در این گذرگاه با چه مشکلاتی روبه‌رو می‌شوید؟
fa.#The cycle path stops before or after th: مسیر دوچرخه قبل یا بعد از گذرگاه قطع می‌شود
fa.#There is no crossing for bicycles: peop: گذرگاهی برای دوچرخه نیست: از خط عابر پیاده استفاده می‌شود
fa.#Cars do not give way to bicycles: خودروها به دوچرخه‌ها حق تقدم نمی‌دهند
fa.#Cars or motorcycles stopped on the cycl: خودرو یا موتورسیکلت متوقف روی مسیر دوچرخه نزدیک گذرگاه
fa.#A curb or step at the entrance of the c: لبه یا پله در ورودی مسیر دوچرخه
fa.#Tram tracks to cross: ریل تراموا که باید از آن رد شد
fa.#The cycle path is not physically separa: مسیر دوچرخه از ترافیک وسایل نقلیه موتوری به‌طور فیزیکی جدا نشده است

hu.#By bicycle or e-scooter, what problems: Kerékpárral vagy elektromos rollerrel milyen problémákat tapasztal ennél az átkelőnél?
hu.#The cycle path stops before or after th: A kerékpárút megszakad az átkelő előtt vagy után
hu.#There is no crossing for bicycles: peop: Nincs kerékpáros átkelő: a zebrát használják
hu.#Cars do not give way to bicycles: Az autók nem adnak elsőbbséget a kerékpárosoknak
hu.#Cars or motorcycles stopped on the cycl: Autók vagy motorok állnak a kerékpárúton az átkelő közelében
hu.#A curb or step at the entrance of the c: Szegély vagy lépcső a kerékpárút bejáratánál
hu.#The cycle path is not physically separa: A kerékpárút nincs fizikailag elválasztva a gépjárműforgalomtól

ar.#By bicycle or e-scooter, what problems: بالدراجة أو السكوتر الكهربائي، ما المشكلات التي تواجهها في هذا المعبر؟
ar.#The cycle path stops before or after th: مسار الدراجات ينقطع قبل المعبر أو بعده
ar.#There is no crossing for bicycles: peop: لا يوجد معبر للدراجات: يُستخدم ممر المشاة
ar.#Cars or motorcycles stopped on the cycl: سيارات أو دراجات نارية متوقفة على مسار الدراجات قرب المعبر
ar.#A curb or step at the entrance of the c: حافة أو درجة عند مدخل مسار الدراجات
ar.#The cycle path is not physically separa: مسار الدراجات غير مفصول ماديًا عن حركة المركبات الآلية
